question: What happens to the first sign when the yogi is absorbed in great bliss?
premises: The yogi becomes absorbed on the ground of great bliss.
From that absorption the first sign responds.
The first sign comes directly face-to-face.
inference: Absorption in great bliss makes the primal sign immediately present to the yogi.
uncertainties: The referent of ādyaṃ liṅgam (first/primal sign) is interpreted from the preceding triadic sequence.
plain_english: For the yogi absorbed on the level of great bliss, the primal sign therefore comes directly face-to-face.
